objective: Qualify source taxonomy, rights/provenance, identity, ontology, derived artifacts, voice representation, conditioning, preservation and evaluator bridge before corpus acquisition.

gates.must: Every admitted source has one rights class and required evidence scoped to jurisdiction/use.
ANALYSIS_ONLY_NO_FULL_TEXT records prohibit persisted full text/passages and permit only nonreconstructive derived representations.
Unknown/ambiguous rights never default to public-domain/licensed admission.
Work, edition, source and passage identities are separate and digest-bound; exact/near duplicates cannot inflate corpus weight.
Work/edition/overlap groups cannot cross training-vs-evaluation boundaries in generalization claims.
Annotations describe transferable craft decisions/effects with conditioning; no named-author technique target exists.
All six required artifact families carry rights/provenance linkage, derivation and digest.
Voice profile is project-specific and based only on user brief/authorized project evidence/user approvals.
Named-author imitation, nearest-author targeting and author-identity optimization are prohibited objectives.
No universal great-prose scalar controls acceptance; decisions are conditioned multi-objective comparisons with preservation hard gates.
Writer and evaluator roles are logically separated; evaluator does not receive scoring-private hidden gold or writer self-justification as authority.
Literary intelligence may supply authorized craft/reference artifacts to the Book evaluator but may not consume hidden-holdout gold or overwrite evaluator evidence/history.
No bulk book acquisition begins before STEP-A passes and a later ingestion objective declares source-by-source admission controls.
